Heads-up! The current version of the Demo is in Chinese only. English and more languages are on the way.

We're also setting up our official Discord server for you to join the community, share feedback, and get the latest news. It will be ready very soon!

Thank you for your patience and support!

About This Game

Empire of Gensokyo ~ TOHOTOPIA is a lightweight 4X war strategy simulation fan game based on the Touhou Project. Under a series of comical misunderstandings, a 4X game craze has started in Gensokyo! The girls eagerly participate, transforming into emperors and generals from world history, leading civilizations of different styles to explore, develop, expand, and conquer on a vast game board map.

Demo Content

  • This demo provides 1 playable faction: Egyptian Empire · Scarlet Dynasty

  • It provides the most basic achievements for summoning Great Persons and constructing Wonders.

  • It provides support for 2 languages: Chinese, English.

Gameplay Overview

  • Choose a Faction: Select one of four initial Gensokyo factions (Palace of the Earth Spirits, Scarlet Devil Mansion, Eientei, Moriya Shrine), which represents a historical empire. Each civilization has unique settings and art style. Each civilization has five special Great Person units with the roles of King, Queen, Rook, Knight, and Bishop, corresponding to 5 girls from the faction. (The demo version only provides the Scarlet Devil Mansion).

  • Take Strategic Actions: In a top-down view, explore unknown areas on a grid map, build cities, develop the economy, form an army, and conquer enemies.

  • Win/Loss Rules: In Classic Mode, getting the highest score in 30 turns is a victory, otherwise it's a failure. In Conquest Mode, eliminating all other players is a victory, and losing all cities is a failure.

  • Game Length: A single game takes about 30 minutes, suitable for casual play and repeated challenges.

A Fantasy Crossover of Touhou Project × Historical Figures!

  • Kaguya Houraisan × Napoleon: How will the princess of Eientei portray the arrogant genius of war?

  • Remilia Scarlet × Osiris: Can the mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion command the majesty of a Pharaoh?

  • Sanae Kochiya × Bismarck: Can the living god of Moriya Shrine recreate the rise of an iron-willed shrine?

  • Satori Komeiji × King Rama: Does the master of the Palace of the Earth Spirits have the wisdom of an ascetic who sees all?

The wonderful interweaving of Gensokyo's girls and world historical figures is the design's original intention and the most charming soul of TOHOTOPIA!

Development Plan

  • The full version will add more Gensokyo × Civilization faction combinations, and the same faction will be able to combine with multiple different civilizations.

  • The full version will add more Gensokyo girl × historical figure combinations, and the same girl can also join different teams to play different roles.

  • Support for multiplayer versus mode.

  • Provide multi-language support.

Please look forward to the full launch of the official version!
